name: Nested GB: Game Boy -> Game Gear (proof of concept)
description: Most SM83 opcodes are the same Z80 bytes, so the game runs as it is on the GG's Z80; the ~16 that differ are rewritten in place or through JP trampolines (ldh -> RST + port byte into an I/O + HRAM shadow, push/pop af with flag-layout tables, ld (hl+/-), DAA, EI, reti, halt). GB VRAM is the GG's cartridge RAM at $8000; once a frame the runtime turns the GB map / tiles / palette into GG name table, 4bpp tiles and colours. RAM code the game copies from ROM is found by the feedback pass (BrokenNes's GB core, Workshop --gbrun --pcs) and patched at its ROM source. The test harness is tools/nested-everything/gbpoc_test.py gg.
status: proof of concept: blargg cpu_instrs 06-ld r,r and 01-special pass on BrokenNes's GG core; 02-interrupts fails #3 (RST-based I/O writes a return address below SP); no sprites, sound, timer, window, MBC beyond bank select
